title: Drazil and His Happy Friends
titleZh: Drazil 和他的快乐朋友们
statementMd:
Drazil has many friends. Some of them are happy and some of them are unhappy. Drazil wants to make all his friends become happy. So he invented the following plan.

There are $*n*$ boys and $*m*$ girls among his friends. Let's number them from $0$ to $*n* - 1$ and $0$ to $*m* - 1$ separately. In $*i*$-th day, Drazil invites ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4b8097bd0e14e104f0d3ee4c567d8dae1d841e28.png)-th boy and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/affc1977a5192853063fd8e722c851c3e5503c85.png)-th girl to have dinner together (as Drazil is programmer, $*i*$ starts from $0$). If one of those two people is happy, the other one will also become happy. Otherwise, those two people remain in their states. Once a person becomes happy (or if it is happy originally), he stays happy forever.

Drazil wants to know on which day all his friends become happy or to determine if they won't become all happy at all.

## Input

The first line contains two integer $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{9}$).

The second line contains integer $*b*$ ($0 ≤ *b* ≤ *min*(*n*, 10^{5})$), denoting the number of happy boys among friends of Drazil, and then follow $*b*$ distinct integers $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*b*}$ ($0 ≤ *x*_{*i*} < *n*$), denoting the list of indices of happy boys.

The third line conatins integer $*g*$ ($0 ≤ *g* ≤ *min*(*m*, 10^{5})$), denoting the number of happy girls among friends of Drazil, and then follow $*g*$ distinct integers $*y*_{1}, *y*_{2}, ... , *y*_{*g*}$ ($0 ≤ *y*_{*j*} < *m*$), denoting the list of indices of happy girls.

It is guaranteed that there is at least one person that is unhappy among his friends.

## Output

Print the number of the first day that all friends of Drazil become happy. If this day won't come at all, you print -1.

## Note

By ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/169ade208e6eb4f9263c57aaff716529d59c3288.png) we define the remainder of integer division of $*i*$ by $*k*$.

In first sample case:

- On the 0-th day, Drazil invites 0-th boy and 0-th girl. Because 0-th girl is happy at the beginning, 0-th boy become happy at this day.
- On the 1-st day, Drazil invites 1-st boy and 1-st girl. They are both unhappy, so nothing changes at this day.
- On the 2-nd day, Drazil invites 0-th boy and 2-nd girl. Because 0-th boy is already happy he makes 2-nd girl become happy at this day.
- On the 3-rd day, Drazil invites 1-st boy and 0-th girl. 0-th girl is happy, so she makes 1-st boy happy.
- On the 4-th day, Drazil invites 0-th boy and 1-st girl. 0-th boy is happy, so he makes the 1-st girl happy. So, all friends become happy at this moment.
statementZhMd:
Drazil 有很多朋友。其中一些人很开心，另一些人不开心。Drazil 想让所有朋友都变得开心。因此，他制定了如下计划。

他的朋友中有 $*n*$ 个男孩和 $*m*$ 个女孩。我们分别将他们编号为 $0$ 到 $*n* - 1$，以及 $0$ 到 $*m* - 1$。在第 $*i*$ 天，Drazil 邀请 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4b8097bd0e14e104f0d3ee4c567d8dae1d841e28.png)-th 个男孩和 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/affc1977a5192853063fd8e722c851c3e5503c85.png)-th 个女孩共进晚餐（由于 Drazil 是程序员，$*i*$ 从 $0$ 开始）。如果这两个人中有一个人开心，那么另一个人也会变得开心。否则，他们两人的状态都不会改变。一旦某个人变得开心（或者他原本就很开心），他就会永远保持开心。

Drazil 想知道所有朋友都变得开心是在第几天，或者判断他们是否永远不可能全部变得开心。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{9}$）。

第二行包含整数 $*b*$（$0 ≤ *b* ≤ *min*(*n*, 10^{5})$），表示 Drazil 的朋友中开心男孩的数量，随后是 $*b*$ 个互不相同的整数 $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*b}$（$0 ≤ *x*_{*i*} < *n*$），表示这些开心男孩的编号。

第三行包含整数 $*g*$（$0 ≤ *g* ≤ *min*(*m*, 10^{5})$），表示 Drazil 的朋友中开心女孩的数量，随后是 $*g*$ 个互不相同的整数 $*y*_{1}, *y*_{2}, ... , *y*_{*g}$（$0 ≤ *y*_{*j*} < *m*$），表示这些开心女孩的编号。

保证他的朋友中至少有一个人不开心。

## 输出格式

输出所有 Drazil 的朋友都变得开心的第一天的编号。如果这一天永远不会到来，则输出 -1。

## 说明

用 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/169ade208e6eb4f9263c57aaff716529d59c3288.png) 表示整数 $*i*$ 除以 $*k*$ 所得的余数。

在第一个样例中：

- 第 0 天，Drazil 邀请第 0 个男孩和第 0 个女孩。由于第 0 个女孩一开始就是开心的，第 0 个男孩在这一天变得开心。
- 第 1 天，Drazil 邀请第 1 个男孩和第 1 个女孩。他们都不开心，因此这一天没有任何变化。
- 第 2 天，Drazil 邀请第 0 个男孩和第 2 个女孩。由于第 0 个男孩已经开心，他让第 2 个女孩在这一天变得开心。
- 第 3 天，Drazil 邀请第 1 个男孩和第 0 个女孩。第 0 个女孩是开心的，因此她让第 1 个男孩变得开心。
- 第 4 天，Drazil 邀请第 0 个男孩和第 1 个女孩。第 0 个男孩是开心的，因此他让第 1 个女孩变得开心。此时，所有朋友都变得开心。
